system.description: You can enter a trance by staring into a flame of any size, gaining insight into the workings of the galaxy by meditating on the flame's movement. Whenever you use the Farseeing Force Power or the Search Your Feelings application of the Use the Force skill, you can reroll your Use the Force check, keeping the better of the two results.
